import sys, os, asyncio
sys.path.insert\(0, os.path.abspath\('.'\)\)
import config
from ingestion.etl import get_db_connection
from ingestion.worker import HenrikAPIClient

CANDIDATES = [\("TenZ", "SEN", "na"\), \("Sacy", "fer", "na"\), \("Asuna", "AK47", "na"\), \("Subroza", "SUB", "na"\)]

conn = get_db_connection\(\)
with conn.cursor\(\) as cur:
    for n, t, r in CANDIDATES:
        cur.execute\("SELECT COUNT\(*\) c FROM players WHERE game_name=%s AND tag_line=%s", \(n, t\)\)
        print\(n, t, "in DB:", cur.fetchone\(\)["c"]\)
conn.close\(\)

async def main\(\):
    c = HenrikAPIClient\(config.HENRIK_API_KEY\)
    try:
        for n, t, r in CANDIDATES:
            try:
                ms = await c.get_matches\(r, n, t, size=1\)
                print\(n, t, "-> exists on Henrik,", len\(ms\), "matches"\)
            except Exception as e:
                print\(n, t, "->", str\(e\)[:80]\)
    finally:
        await c.close\(\)
asyncio.run\(main\(\)\)
EOF)
